title: Compass and Provision
author: Oscar Vasquez
blurb: Hazel Marchetti, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
